uncertainty: Six bounded Packagist searches saved 546 hits and 412 distinct package names. Eleven pinned third-party package paths passed the valid local one-page PDF control; nine more are needed for the 20-path working goal. FPDI and iio/libmergepdf share an FPDI parser family; Spatie and ottosmops share Poppler; mikehaertl/php-pdftk invokes pdftk-java. Four named high-adoption leads remain untested, and most search hits were not inspected, so no definitive most-used top-eleven claim is asserted. PHP Fileinfo provides MIME only, GD rejects PDF input, and generic file I/O and FFI do not parse PDF by themselves. Packagist lifetime downloads rank verified Composer paths only within PHP and include unrelated-format uses.
